tools.name: get_market_sample
tools.description: FREE sample of the crypto market pulse (same JSON shape as paid /v1/pulse): spots, Fear & Greed, Hyperliquid funding, DefiLlama TVL/yields, plus a plain-English summary line. Data may be up to 15 minutes old. Use get_market_pulse for live paid data.

tools.name: get_market_pulse
tools.description: Live full pulse ($0.02 USDC on Solana via x402 after free quota). One free live GET /v1/pulse per client per UTC day with headers X-Crypto-Pulse-Free:1 and X-Pulse-Client-Id. Bare GET still returns HTTP 402 for x402 discovery. This MCP tool returns payment requirements + HTTP URL. Free stale preview

tools.name: get_market_spots
tools.description: PAID live BTC/ETH/SOL/SUI/HYPE/ZEC spot prices only ($0.005 USDC). Returns payment requirements + HTTP URL for x402. Prefer get_market_pulse when you also need Fear & Greed, funding, or DeFi. Free preview: get_market_sample.

tools.name: arena_prize_wallet
tools.description: FREE: public prize wallet address, live USDC/SOL balances, autopay on/off, and recent payout history with Solscan links. No secrets.

tools.name: arena_current_round
tools.description: FREE: current Crypto Pulse Prediction Arena round timing (open/cutoff/close UTC), whether entries are accepted, entry counts, and top of leaderboard (prizeEligible reflects the /v1/pulse rule from round 2026-11-13). No payment.

tools.name: arena_submit_prediction
tools.description: FREE: submit or update a signed price prediction for the current (or given) arena round. Assets are BTC, ETH, and SOL. Pass a pre-signed payload — the server never receives private keys. Sign the canonical message from arena_rules / arena_current_round (ed25519, signature base58). Through round 2026

tools.name: arena_referrals
tools.description: FREE: list bots referred by a payout wallet, their 3-day pulse+predict progress, and referral earnings (base $0.005 / bonus $0.01 USDC). Same data as GET /v1/arena/referrals?wallet=.

tools.name: arena_leaderboard
tools.description: FREE: arena leaderboard. Default is the current daily round. Set weekly=true (optional week=Monday YYYY-MM-DD) for the weekly board: best average daily score among prize-eligible bots that entered at least 5 of 7 rounds Mon–Sun UTC and were prize-eligible under the rule in force on at least one appl

tools.name: arena_history
tools.description: FREE: recent Arena rounds history (closes, predictions, scores, prize winners, payout status). Optional limit (default 10). For CSV use GET /v1/arena/history?format=csv.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_market_pulse, get_market_spots, arena_submit_prediction · Private data: arena_rules, arena_prize_wallet, arena_submit_prediction, arena_referrals, arena_leaderboard · Public sink: arena_rules, arena_submit_prediction · Destructive: arena_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_market_pulse, get_market_spots, arena_submit_prediction · Private data: arena_rules, arena_prize_wallet, arena_submit_prediction, arena_referrals, arena_leaderboard · Public sink: arena_rules, arena_submit_prediction · Destructive: arena_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "arena_rules" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
